senses.gloss:
अञ्ज् अञ्ज्, cl. 7. P. A. अनक्ति, अङ्क्ते,
आनञ्ज, अञ्जिष्यति or अङ्क्ष्यति, आञ्जीत्,
अञ्जितुम् or अङ्क्तुम्, to apply an ointment or pig-
ment, smear with, anoint; to decorate, prepare; to
honour, celebrate; to cause to appear, to make clear,
distinguish, represent; to be beautiful; to go: Caus.
अञ्जयति, -यितुम्, आञ्जिजत्, to smear with; to speak,
shine, to cause to go [cf. Lat. ungo].

आञ्ज् आञ्ज् (आ-अञ्ज्), cl. 7. P. आनक्ति, आञ्जि-
तुम् or आङ्क्तुम्, to anoint; to smooth, polish, pre-
pare; to honour, receive respectfully.

अञ्जक, अस्, m., N. of a son of Vipracitti; of a son
of Yadu.

अञ्जन, अस्, m. a kind of domestic lizard; N. of a
fabulous serpent; of a tree; of a mountain; of a king
of Mithilā; of the elephant of the west or south-west
quarter; (अम्), n. act of applying an ointment or pig-
ment, embellishing, &c.; black pigment or collyrium
applied to the eye-lashes or the inner coat of the eye-
lids; special kind or material of this pigment, as
lamp-black, Antimony, an extract of Ammonium,
Xanthorrhiza, &c.; paint, especially as a cosmetic;
magic ointment; ink; night; fire. (In rhetoric)
suggesting the special meaning alluded to in an ex-
pression, as in a pun, &c.
—अञ्जन-केशी, f., N. of a
vegetable perfume.
—अञ्जन-नामिका, f. a swelling
of the eyelid, stye.
—अञ्जन-वत्, ind. like collyrium.
—अञ्जनाधिका (˚न-अध्˚), f. a species of lizard.
—अञ्जनाम्भस् (˚न-अम्˚), अस्, n. eye-water.

अञ्जना, f., N. of Hanumat's mother; of Pravara-
sena's mother.
—अञ्जना-गिरि, इस्, m., N. of a moun-
tain.
—अञ्जना-वती, f. the female elephant of the
north-east (or the west ?) quarter.
अञ्जना; add — a kind of lizard.

आञ्जन, अम्, ई, n. f. ointment, especially for the
eyes; fat.
—आञ्जनाभ्यञ्जनीय (˚न-अभ्य्˚), अम्,
आ, n. f., N. of a certain ceremony.
—आञ्जनी-कारी, f.
a woman who anoints or makes ointments.

आञ्जन; add — (अस्, ई, अम्), having the colour of
ointment.

अञ्जनक, अस्, m. portion of the Vedas containing
the word अञ्जन.
—अञ्जनकी, f., N. of a medicinal
plant.

अञ्जनिक, अस्, आ, अम्, connected with collyrium;
(आ), f. a species of lizard; a small mouse.

अञ्जनी, f. a woman fit for the application of oint-
ments, pigments, sandal, &c.; N. of two medicinal plants.
अञ्जल, अञ्जलि, see s. v. below.

अञ्जल अञ्जल (only at the end of com-
pounds), another form for अञ्जलि, q. v.

अञ्जस्, अस्, n., Ved. ointment, preparation (?);
smoothness, sliding, speed (?); a good fit, adaptation (?);
(according to others, आस्, आस्, अस्), level, straight,
right.
—अञ्जस्-पा, आस्, आस्, अम्, Ved. drinking the Soma
preparation.
—अञ्जः-सव, अस्, m. rapid preparation
of Soma.

अञ्जस, अस्, आ, अम्, straight, straightforward, honest;
(ई), f., Ved., N. of a heavenly river.

अञ्जसा or अञ्जस्, ind. straight on, right, truly, justly;
quickly, soon, instantly.

अञ्जसायन (˚सा-अय्˚), अस्, ई, अम्, having a straight
course, going straight on.

अञ्जसीन, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. going straight on,
straightforward.

अञ्जि, इस्, इस्, इ, applying an ointment or pigment;
ointment, brilliancy, unctuous, slimy; shining, bril-
liant; (इस्, इ), m. n. the sexual organ, i. e. distinguishing
the sex; (इस्), m. a sender, commander.
—अञ्जि-मत्,
आन्, अती, अत्, Ved. coloured, bright, adorned.
—अञ्जि-
सक्थ, अस्, m. (a victim) that has coloured thighs.
अञ्जि; add — an ornament.
अञ्जी अञ्जी, f. a blessing (?).
अञ्जिन्, ई, इनी, इ, Ved. making clear or manifest.
अञ्जिव, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. slippery, smooth.

अञ्जिष्ठ, अस्, m., Ved. (highly brilliant), the sun;
also अञ्जिष्णु, उस्, m.

अञ्जलि अञ्जलि, इस्, m. (fr. rt. अञ्ज्), the open
[]
hands placed side by side and slightly hollowed, as if
by a beggar to receive food; hence when raised to the
forehead, a mark of supplication, reverence, salutation
or benediction; a libation; a measure of corn, sufficient
to fill both hands when placed side by side, equal to a
kuḍava.
—अञ्जलि-कर्मन्, अ, n. making the अञ्जलि
or respectful salutation.
—अञ्जलि-कारिका, f. an earthen
doll, making the अञ्जलि; N. of a plant, probably
Mimosa Natans.
—अञ्जलि-पुट, अस्, अम्, m. n. cavity
produced in making the अञ्जलि.
—अञ्जलि-बन्धन,
अम्, n. salutation with the अञ्जलि raised to the fore-
head.
—अञ्जली-क्रित, अस्, आ, अम्, (hands) placed to-
gether to form the अञ्जलि.

अञ्जलिक, अस्, अम्, m. n., N. of one of Arjuna's
arrows; see कर्ण-पर्व, 4788; (आ), a young mouse.

अञ्जिक अञ्जिक, अस्, m., N. of a son of Yadu.
See अञ्जक.
आञ्जिक आञ्जिक, अस्, m., N. of a Dānava.

अञ्जिहिषा अञ्जिहिषा, f. (fr. Desid. of rt.
अंह्), desire of going.

अञ्जीर अञ्जीर, अम्, n. a species of fig-tree
(Ficus Oppositifolia); a fig. (In Bengālī) a guava.
(अञ्जीर is a Persian word.)

आञ्जनेय आञ्जनेय, अस्, m. (fr. अञ्जना, his
mother), N. of the monkey Hanumat.

आञ्जलिक्य आञ्जलिक्य (fr. अञ्जलिक). See
Gaṇa to Pāṇini V. 1. 128.

आञ्जिनेय आञ्जिनेय, अस्, m. an insect, a kind
of lizard, Lacerta Unjinensis. See अञ्जन and अञ्-
जनिका.
